name: 腾讯自选股·金融数据查询
description_zh: 基于腾讯自选股行情数据接口的结构化金融数据查询底座：支持 A股/港股/美股个股、指数、ETF、板块、期货、外汇、可转债的 K 线与分时行情、财务报表、资金流向、技术指标、筹码成本、股东结构、分红除权、业绩预告、龙虎榜、大宗交易、融资融券等数据查询，并覆盖行业经营数据、申万行业估值与全球宏观经济数据。
description_en: A structured financial data query platform based on Tencent's self-selected stock market data interface: Supports K-line and intraday market data, financial statements, capital flows, technical indicators, cost of shares, shareholder structure, dividend ex-rights, earnings forecasts, top gainers and losers lists, block trades, margin trading and securities lending, etc. for A-shares/Hong Kong stocks/US stocks, indices, ETFs, sectors, futures, foreign exchange, and convertible bonds. It also covers industry operating data, Shenwan industry valuations and global macroeconomic data.
